title: Golden Yellow Shower Curtain Rod Brackets, 1-Inch Rod, Wall Mount Solid Brass, Pair, Allied Brass
description: Shower curtain rod brackets for 1-inch diameter shower rods, wall mount solid brass pair for supporting a bathroom shower curtain rod installation in Golden Yellow, which radiates warm, sunny energy that brightens any bathroom with cheerful, optimistic personality. Designed for use with any 1 in shower rod (rod sold separately). Traditional style brackets with concealed screw mounting and included installation hardware. Each bracket measures 3 in L x 2.25 in H x 3 in W with 2 in projection; product weight 1.6 lb and rated 2 lb weight capacity. Finish-neutral MasterSKU offered in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes. Limited lifetime warranty. Part of the Prestige Regal collection for classic bath accessories and traditional bathroom hardware coordination.
